findings.rationale: identical dynamic block added twice instead of a shared local
findings.explanation: This dynamic block is byte-identical to the one added in modules/self-managed-node-group/main.tf, including the for_each guard. Two copies means a future change to the guard has to be found and applied twice, and the launch-template resources are already the pair that drifted last time.

findings.rationale: new optional attribute accepts any string for bandwidth_weighting
findings.explanation: The declared object type constrains bandwidth_weighting to a string but not to the values EC2 accepts, so a typo surfaces as an API error during apply rather than at plan time. A validation block catches it before any infrastructure is touched.
